liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Box of Rain** (6 reviews, 1 other source): Pedal steel and piano can almost be made out on Box of Rain in this version; Phil's vocals on Box of Rain come through strongly despite the weak recording [4][11][14][15][16][17][19]
- **Friend of the Devil** (1 review): Friend of the Devil is a strong performance, but the muffled recording undermines it [13]
- **Cold Jordan** (1 other source): John Dawson joined for Cold Jordan and Swing Low Sweet Chariot [4]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): Dark Star is singled out as especially nice [15]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): An acoustic Truckin' is another rarity; reviewer couldn't find these songs listed in Deadbase [16]

## Setlist highlights

- **Truckin' False Start**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **TruckinÂ**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 3 archived performances [21]
- **Swing Low Sweet Chariot**: rare: 13 archived performances [21]
- **Six Days on the Road**: rare: 13 archived performances [21]
- **I DonÂt Know You**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **Superman**: rare: 10 archived performances [21]
- **Cecilia**: rare: 8 archived performances [21]
- **Good LovinÂ**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 3 archived performances [21]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Box of Rain [21]

## The recordings

- **gd70-09-17.aud.warner.16090.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 24 songs; 118 min; rated 3.38/5 by 16 [1]. Said about its sound: Audience tape is muffled and rough, with crowd voices clearly audible, though the age gives it some character; Audience recording is very poor and would benefit greatly from cleanup, despite the strong material; Tape sounds very muffled, as though the microphone had been covered with clothing [9][10][13][16]
- **gd70-09-17.aud.remaster.sirmick.27591.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 23 songs; 118 min; rated 3/5 by 11 [2]. Said about its sound: This remaster is a few generations newer than the other tape and somewhat more listenable, though still difficult; Recording is weak; reviewer hopes a clear soundboard of this show will surface; Rickety recording; hopes for a soundboard, but finds it quaint [11][14][17]
- **gd1970-09-17.145892.partials3.akg190e.weinberg.wolfe.smith.joeb.sirmick.flac24**: audience recording; 3 songs; 48 min [6]
- **gd1970-09-17.aud.cbass.15983.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 18 songs; 96 min; rated 2.83/5 by 6 [3]

## Around the show

- David Nelson joined the band for Dark Hollow, Friend of the Devil, Ripple, Rosalie McFall, Cold Jordan and Swing Low [4]
- Reviewer ranks the acoustic set among the best of 1970 and among the most developed [11]
- Reviewer rates this show good, but below the 19 September show [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd70-09-17.aud.warner.16090.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Jack Toner; transferred by Dwight Holmes, David Minches, Jack Warner; source: Audience [1]. Also: Reviewer says the Dead's vault lacks tapes from mid-July to mid-December 1970, making this copy valuable; Dark Star comes from a different source, with unknown taper and equipment [1][19]
- **gd70-09-17.aud.remaster.sirmick.27591.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Jack Toner; transferred by Dwight Holmes, David Minches, Jack Warner, SIRMick; source: Remastered Audience [2]
- **gd1970-09-17.145892.partials3.akg190e.weinberg.wolfe.smith.joeb.sirmick.flac24**: taped by Marty Weinberg; transferred by Don Wolfe, Matt Smith, Sirmick; source: Source: AKG190E > Uher 400L > Master Audience Reel > ??? > Reel 3.75 ips (low gen) - Recorded by Marty Weinberg and provided by Don Wolfe [6]. Also: Remaster built from partial sources; many small dropouts repaired and several patches added; Good Lovin' received patches using another source, including one larger patch [6]
- **gd1970-09-17.aud.cbass.15983.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by cbass; source: MAC>Reel>Cassette>DAT>CD>EAC>SHN [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by gocollect.com: [Grateful Dead The Fillmore East PROG 1970 Value - GoCollect](https://gocollect.com/concert-poster/grateful-dead-fillmore-east-program) [22]
